notes.title: Shivers, swag, shenanigans
notes.notes:
[h1]Your quick peek at some the Halloween events in upjers games[/h1]

The night of Halloween is looming ahead. This means it‘s party-time for upjers!

We want to give you an overview on the [b]Halloween-Events[/b] starting across many games next 
week. Here‘s what you can expect:​

[h1]My Little Farmies[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/789100/My_Little_Farmies/

From [b]October 22nd to 29th[/b] the Halloween-themed collector-event is waiting for you. Decorate your village with eeriely-cute Voodoo decorations to collect all the [b]Shrunken head[/b]-tokens to win valuable prizes like the new [b]„Saddler‘s“[/b] production facility. There you can craft saddles and other products.

[h1]My Free Zoo[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/694130/My_Free_Zoo/

Is this too morbid for you? Then you may already be looking forward to collect [b]Lionhead tokens[/b] at My Free Zoo. Put up scary-looking glow-in-the-dark animal statues to have the chance to win the adorable and very exclusive [b]Siberian musk deer[/b] to exhibit in your zoo. ([i]The events runs 
between October 23rd and 30th.[/i])

[h1]My Free Farm[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049880/My_Free_Farm/

This year the My Free Farm Halloween-Event is challenging your gray matter again! The [b]Halloween card-matching game[/b] is back! When you mange to clear all cards from the table within ten tries, you have the chance to win new amusing trophies for your collection. ([i]October 22nd 
through to November 5th[/i].)

But also your  [b]Horse Farm[/b] (24 – 30 October), [b]Wauies[/b] (24 – 31 October), [b]My Sunny Resort[/b] (23 – 30 October) and [b]My Free Farm 2[/b] (29 October – 5 November) are packed full with fun events 
to take the edge off the dark season.

notes.title: Little Imps available now!
notes.notes:
The quiet days are over! The sound of numerous imps working to expand the underground lair puts a smile on the face of even the most miserable rules of the deep. With its humorous fantasy elements, its online coop mode and unique battle features, dungeon tycoon game „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is the right game for any aspiring prince of darkness.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026505/9b43b55f5a92a4f01249e20ff71909953a39fbaf.jpg[/img]

The Steam early access version of „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is now available.

notes.title: Time to Get to Work!
notes.notes:
Limited Time Only: 25% on Staff-Related Costs

From now until [b]Wednesday, September 5[/b], you can [b]save big[/b] on [b]staff[/b] in My Sunny Resort. You'll get [b]25 percent off[/b] all employee-related fees that costs shells - that includes [b]hiring, training, extending[/b] and [b]relocating[/b] your staff!

Experience this fantastic event! We look forward to your visit!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32611818/aa3b9ddfc0f6d6942fd3c7c3aa1bc4053804f55f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Limited Time Only: Get a Free Booster with Every Booster Purchase
notes.notes:
From now [b]until Wednesday, August 15[/b], at 11:00 am CEST, when you [b]buy a booster[/b], you'll get a [b]second booster[/b] of the same type [b]free[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32611818/6744d89f455f277d698ea94d43660fac5b20ff99.jpg[/img]

 That means: If you buy a silver booster during the event, you'll get another silver booster free. If you buy a gold booster, you'll get another gold booster; if you buy a bronze booster, you'll get a second bronze booster on top.

 Come check out this [b]wonderful opportunity[/b]. We wish you [b]lots of fun[b] in your virtual holiday resort.

notes.title: Happy 3rd Birthday!
notes.notes:
All players that log in on [b]May 17th[/b] between 12:00 am and 11:59 pm CEST, will receive a [b]special birthday gift[/b]:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32611818/7b84ca5808d14506b53d8f22acb8aea62ce3d2aa.jpg[/img]

This mouthwatering cake increases the [b]comfort[/b] of the building you put it in by a whopping [b]20%[/b]!

It's also [b]Buy One, get One Free Booster Week[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32611818/6744d89f455f277d698ea94d43660fac5b20ff99.jpg[/img]

From now until [b]May 23[/b] at [b]10:59 am CEST[/b], whenever you buy a suitcase (booster), you'll get [b]another suitcase[/b] of the same rarity for [b]free[/b]! So if you buy a [b]Gold Suitcase[/b] during the event, you'll get a[b] second Gold Suitcase[/b] [b]free[/b]!

This is a great opportunity to work on acquiring our exclusive booster items! Each gold suitcase is guaranteed to contain a piece of [b]Agnes' Autumn Cottage[/b] and one piece of the following: peacock, flamingo, bird of paradise flower or frangipani tree!

notes.title: Mother's Day Event
notes.notes:
Hurray for moms! My Sunny Resort is getting ready for the big weekend with a slew of lovely flowers and some amazingly cuddly plushies. Enjoy our [b]Mother's Day Event[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32611818/ad96307ffb06affeff8f8dfd3ac0e660fddfd21b.jpg[/img]

For the duration of the event, all players [b]level[/b] 9 and up will find the seasonal section of your shop stocked with cute plushies, colorful tulips and a gorgeous decorated tree.

Each Mother's Day decoration you place in your resort will give you points in the form of [b]Teddy Bears[/b].

Collecting enough Teddy Bears  before the event ends on [b]May 16 at 10:59am CEST[/b] will allow you to earn some exciting rewards, including an all-new NPC - [b]Teddy Freddy[/b]!

[b]1,000 Teddy Bears[/b] - Duckling
[b]2,250 Teddy Bears[/b] - 8 Teddy Freddy Pieces
[b]4,750 Teddy Bears[/b] - Gold Booster
[b]9,000 Teddy Bears[/b] - Blossoming Pear Tree
[b]15,000 Teddy Bears[/b] - 12 Teddy Freddy Pieces
[b]25,000 Teddy Bears[/b] - Blossoming Apple Tree
[b]38,000 Teddy Bears[/b] - Fat Corgi
[b]60,000 Teddy Bears[/b] - 30 Teddy Freddy Pieces

The Duckling, Blossoming Pear Tree, Blossoming Apple Tree and Fat Corgi are prizes from last year's event. So if you missed them last year, now's your chance to get them and start cuddling!

[b]Teddy Freddy[/b] is an [b]NPC[/b] that can be placed in any of your resorts. Every 10 hours, he'll have a gift for you - experience points, Hotel Dollars or even landmark pieces!

[b]Please note:[/b] [b]Only decorations placed in your resort when the event ends on May 16, 2017 at 10:59am CEST will count towards your reward. Items in your inventory will not count! So make sure to place everything you buy IN YOUR RESORTS.[/b]
